test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 12 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words.**

While I was travelling in Europe, I met a __man who drew maps__.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Cartographer**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Cartographer**'.
 
• **Cartographer**: मानचित्रकार (Manchitrakar) - a person who draws or produces maps.
